---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or design change
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What's missing or awkward today? Who does it affect (players, contributors,
operators)?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Reference the relevant design doc if there is one
(Bash Entertainment wiki: "Engine Architecture", "Engine Architecture:
Input, Netplay, and Content Pipeline", "Combat Model: Knockback, Hitstun,
and DI", etc.) and say how this fits or changes it.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them.

## Scope / affected packages

Which package(s) this touches (`sim`, `render`, `input`, `net`, `content`,
`app`) and whether it's a breaking change to an existing data format or
API.
